1) Can we favour morning windows (SG/HK morning) rather than your typical PST-friendly afternoons? We have a mix of folks in SG, HK, and Sydney and mornings reduce split attendance.
2) We need Redwood to validate SSO/SAML readiness before hands-on labs so our identity team can sign off. I’ve attached the BrightBank SAML team’s checklist and the list of initial users.

Thanks — I can loop in our security lead if useful.

Best,

Hi Lia — great to hear and thanks for the checklist. We can absolutely prioritize morning blocks for SG/HK. Quick note on approach so we’re aligned before we lock dates: 

- Bracketing plan: two half-day cohorts (AM slot 08:30–12:30 SGT) + a single evening fallback (19:00–22:00 SGT) if there are last-minute infra or attendee conflicts. The evening fallback will be handled from our EMEA crew.
- SSO prep: our SRE/identity engineer will do a short validation call 3–5 days before the workshop and run the SAML checklist you sent. We’ll also need a test user account with admin consent to complete the flow.
- Prework: we suggest attendees complete the quick access checklist (browser versions, VPN rules, service account keys) 48 hours prior.

Marissa is copied for commercial availability and Jordan for runbook/recording ownership. I’ll attach a session-bracketing CSV with suggested times across the three days and ask Marissa to confirm the cohort size tolerances for hands-on labs.

Cheers,
